obligations.note: POST /payees/{id}/reopen is registered for privileged action manage_payees with mfa=False, and the exhaustive control test fails listing that route. EXC-0189 does not cure it: it was approved by requester Linh Nguyen, who has no risk_owner role, and the route drops MFA for every caller while the exception text is limited to the reconciliation batch account.
reopen_payee writes only status and closed_at. The exhaustive test tests.controls.test_encryption_control#test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed in the CI report.
The new UPDATE is a fixed SQL string with the payee id bound as a parameter. tests.controls.test_sql_control#test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed.
LedgerService.reopen_payee calls _audit, which records the actor, action, target, and clock time. tests.controls.test_audit_control#test_sampled_operations_are_audited passed.

reopen_payee sets status to open and clears closed_at, so the payee leaves the closed-payee purge set. closed_payees_before still selects only closed rows with closed_at before the cutoff and npi_purged_at null, and the retention control test passed.
Ticket CHG-25131 is status approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-06, before review, and its components cover payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service, and payments.store.
Sofia Santos is a payments change_approver, is not the author, and recorded a code_review approval of the head commit.
The change is the single commit 764bd216e49bcbb14d74ef0beaa18aec0b0e3167, and the code review and security review both name that commit.
records/ci/run.json records result failure on the head commit. The JUnit report has one failure, tests.controls.test_routes_control#test_privileged_routes_require_mfa, so the full suite did not pass.
app.py, routes.py, and store.py are security_sensitive. Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer, approved a security_review of the head commit.
The diff is only application code under apps/baseline-payments. No path listed in controls/protected-paths.json changed, so a control-owner approval is not required.
Ticket CHG-25131 is type standard and the change record sets emergency to false, so the post-implementation review deadline is not triggered.

The MFA deviation is presented under EXC-0189, which is approved by the requester rather than a CISO-office risk owner. The exception scope names the reconciliation batch account, while the route disables MFA for every caller.
Acceptance record ACR-0404 covers routes.py for MFA-1 with exhaustive evidence. This change alters that file, so the prior evidence lapses, and the replacement control test on the head commit failed.

summary: The change adds POST /payees/{id}/reopen on privileged action manage_payees with MFA turned off. EXC-0189 cannot authorize that deviation because Linh Nguyen approved their own request and does not hold the risk_owner role, and the route is not limited to the batch account named in the exception. CI on the head commit fails the exhaustive privileged-route control, so the testing requirement and the lapsed routes.py evidence are also unmet. Parameterized SQL, sealed NPI, the reopen audit record, and the ticket and independent reviews are in order, but the MFA break requires rejection.
